action.action-desc: Mr. Deluzio introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce

form.official-title: To amend the Higher Education Act of 1965 to provide opportunities for students at institutions of higher education to study trades, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Pathway to Trades Act.

section.header: Agreements with institutions for Federal Perkins Loans
section.text: Section 463(a) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1087cc(a)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in paragraph (8), by striking and at the end;
by redesignating paragraph (9) as paragraph (10); and
by inserting after paragraph (8) the following:
provide that the institution of higher education will—

subparagraph.text: designate a faculty member as a point of contact for students studying, or interested in studying, trades; and
develop courses for students relating to trades; and
